The '''Kreetan Narrows''' was a region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It included the [[Periphery/Legends|Periphery]], the [[Boz Pity Salient]], and [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] such as the [[Honoghr system/Legends|Honoghr system]], the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]], the [[Sriluur system/Legends|Sriluur system]] and the [[Vaath'kror system]].

==History==
Originally, the Kreetan Narrows were controlled by the [[Hutt Clan|Hutt Cartel]]. However, at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] presence was substantially reduced by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], but the Kreetan Narrows remained under Hutt control. In the months following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the surrounding regions were the site of important [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist]] [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection|activity]]. After their defeat at the [[Battle of Trasemene|battle]] of [[Trasemene]], the Separatist retreated to the Kreetan Narrows, but were followed by the Imperial forces who [[Annexation of the northern Hutt territories|annexed]] the Kreetan Narrows, which were split and shared between five [[Sector/Legends|sectors]], the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep]], [[Tharin sector/Legends|Tharin]], [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron]], [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel]] and [[Bheriz sector/Legends|Bheriz sectors]].
